'''Encheeko''' was a continent on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. On its southwestern coast was the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Matza]]. The capital city of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]] was also located here on the [[Sika Peninsula/Legends|Sika Peninsula]], around [[Chattza Bay]].<ref name="SotEPG" />
